author: NHSpeedy
text: The time trials this tour are the return of Tokyo Blur 4 and the debuts of Singapore Speedway R and Bangkok Rush 2. The previous World Record for Tokyo Blur 4 was set by Kaguya with a time of 46.31. Best of luck to everybody grinding this tour!
finding: Authoritative organizer identifies pre-tour Tokyo Blur 4 standing WR46.31, and confirms two new course variants. This provides a real threshold for intermediate Tokyo runs, rather than treating every personal improvement as WR.
nextAction: Reconcile all Tokyo runs faster than46.31 in first-publication order, including original videos46.17 Sucha,46.16 kNo2,46.08 Sucha and missing earlier faster runs; use submission index and surrounding context. New variants still require first-hour rival order.
